newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - J&J to acquire Biopsys.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - J&J to acquire Biopsys.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson agreed to acquire Biopsys Medical Inc, a company that produces products for breast biopsies, in a stock deal valued at $310 million.
Johnson & Johnson and Biopsys Medical Inc Agree to Stock-for-Stock Merger Valued at Approximately $310 Million

NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J. May 22 /PRNewswire/ -- Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ), the world's leading health care corporation, and California-based Biopsys Medical, Inc. (Nasdaq: BIOP), which produces products for minimally invasive breast biopsies, today announced they have executed a definitive agreement providing for a stock-for-stock merger valued at approximately $310 million.
The Boards of Directors of both companies have approved the merger.

"This is a very important strategic advance for our worldwide minimally invasive surgery franchise," said William C. Weldon, Johnson & Johnson Company Group Chairman. "While we are delighted with the agreement, we are even more excited about the potential this innovative technology has for improving the quality of life for women around the world."
Steven L. Gex, President and Chief Executive Officer of Irvine, Calif.- based Biopsys Medical, Inc., echoed Weldon, calling the agreement "a key to advancing women's health care."

Gex added, "Johnson & Johnson has a strong global presence as well as an outstanding reputation with consumers and clinicians everywhere. This merger assures us that our minimally invasive procedure and diagnostic devices for breast cancer will be an available option much sooner to women throughout the world."

The MAMMOTOME Breast Biopsy Procedure, pioneered and marketed by Biopsys Medical, Inc., is an innovative, minimally invasive procedure requiring only a local anesthetic and provides multiple tissue samples through a small, single insertion probe for breast cancer diagnosis. It eliminates the need for a large open surgical incision and, typically, the procedure is performed on an outpatient basis in a physician's office or hospital setting.
Robertson Stephens & Company has provided financial advisory services to the Biopsys Medical, Inc. Board of Directors.

The amount of Johnson & Johnson stock that would be issued in the merger for each Biopsys Medical share would be the result of dividing $27.55 by the average closing price per Johnson & Johnson share for the 20 trading days preceding the date of the last full trading day prior to a meeting of Biopsys Medical stockholders to approve the merger.

The merger is subject to the approval of Biopsys Medical stockholders and other customary conditions, including clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act. Certain Biopsys Medical stockholders, who collectively own in excess of 3.2 million shares (approximately one-third of the outstanding shares), have agreed to vote their shares for the merger.

In the event of an unsolicited alternative transaction with Biopsys Medical, there would be a fee payable to Johnson & Johnson of $10 million and Johnson & Johnson would have an option to acquire from Biopsys Medical 19.9% of Biopsys Medical common stock at a price of $27.55 per share.

Johnson & Johnson, with 1996 sales of $21.6 billion, is the world's leading and most comprehensive manufacturer of health care products serving the consumer, pharmaceutical, diagnostic and professional markets. Johnson & Johnson has more than 89,000 employees and 170 companies in more than 50 countries around the world, selling products in more than 150 countries.
Biopsys Medical, Inc. is the leading developer, manufacturer and marketer of products for the diagnosis and management of breast cancer. SOURCE Johnson & Johnson
